# Baked Build specs

Committed, embedded Build specs (TECHSPEC §4, ADR-0007). One JSON file per cache
key `{blueprintId}_{taskId}_{contractHash}_{model}.json`, generated by:

    set -a; . ./.env; set +a
    go run ./cmd/bake -task foundation-1 -type foundation

These are declarative geometry DATA, not secrets — they let the headline replay a
generated spec deterministically with no API key and no model call. The embedded
cache (embed.go) skips this README and loads only `*.json`.
